prompt:
FaithPath Lichtkrone STAGE 1 SEED. Derive a premium close-up belonging to the supplied mature tree's same Mediterranean ground, right pale stone, warm upper-right light and botanical painted material. Reference1 is the existing olive SEED starting point, reference2 the approved mature tree material identity.
One real olive pit, oval elongated with natural irregular longitudinal ridges and matte tan/umber woody surface, resting partly nestled in the warm sandy soil. It is a SEED, no germination, no sprout, no leaves on the seed. Small surrounding ordinary wild ground shoots are optional but must not be confused with a germinating tree. No magic, aura, light beams, fantasy glow or religious lettering. Honest subtle natural texture, not a plastic almond.
True transparent square 1254x1254. Compose as a deliberate macro portrait: the single pit is the clear subject around centre (640,790), approximately 560px wide and 310px high, gently tilted right. A small connected soil island beneath it, common pale stone at lower right and a few small pebbles, with soil base near y1150. Keep some breathing room above but do not leave three quarters of the canvas empty: the seed and soil should fill the central/lower two thirds naturally. Soft tactile ground shadows matching the mature source, silver-sage understated tiny ground foliage if present, no duplicate objects. All edges complete inside at least 25px transparent margins. No scene backdrop, page, text, labels, border, UI or horizon panorama. This is an optical close-up of the beginning of the same Lichtkrone, not a new unrelated icon.

FaithPath Lichtkrone STAGE 2 SEEDLING, a coherent next age of the attached seed and future mature tree. True transparent square 1254x1254, one connected botanical subject. Use reference1 existing seedling for its graceful S-shaped stem and opposite olive leaves; reference2 NEW seed ground/stone and reference3 APPROVED adult for material/light family.
Draw a small living olive seedling emerging from the same warm sandy soil island, pale stone at lower RIGHT, soft warm upper-right illumination. A delicate gently S-curved stem from soil around (650,1080), arching toward (620,540), then upward to a tiny pale unopened leaf tip. Two or three opposite pairs of narrow lanceolate silver-green olive leaves, different turns, one pale underside; fine natural leaf veins, supple thin petioles visibly attached. No fruit, flowers, mature bark, giant roots, no magical glow. New roots at ground contact can be barely exposed, slender and believable.
Compose as a premium optical close-up with clear generous transparent margin 35px on ALL sides. Complete high leaf tips and outer ground edges must NOT be cut by the canvas. Leaf canopy mainly x220–1050, y140–790; soil base near y1190. Same visual finish as approved botanical master, matte tactile painted realism, finely drawn organic contours rather than glossy plastic or a flat icon. Preserve the future tree's quiet S movement and the right-stone setting. No separate foliage tufts, repeated leaf fan stamps, grass scenery, background, paper, text, labels, UI or frame. One coherent seedling picture only.

FaithPath Lichtkrone — derive STAGE 3 YOUNG OLIVE TREE from the ATTACHED APPROVED MATURE MASTER. One connected whole botanical illustration, transparent square 1254x1254. Same individual tree at an early age, same camera, ground height, pale stone at lower right, warm upper-right light and matte silver-sage leaf material. Keep the ROOT CONTACT near (650,1100) and small soil island ending y1195; stone roughly (925,1145). Tree grows along the characteristic S-curved axis from roots (650,1100) through (635,900),(580,760),(520,650) towards a higher left leader around (480,450). Establish the characteristic low RIGHT elbow limb from around (630,850) towards (825,800) then upwards towards (900,610) as a SLENDER living branch, not an amputated stump. These are shared identity anchors with the mature source, not instructions to put text.
Truly YOUNG wood: slim supple grey-umber stem, a shallow elongated closed scar where the later hollow will be, NO ancient massive twisted log, no large open hollow, no bonsai-looking old trunk. Delicate exposed root starts, no large adult root ropes. A small but naturally CONNECTED airy crown made of many variable little olive twigs, narrow opposite lanceolate leaves. Left leader slightly taller than right. Crown extends roughly x300–990, y350–760. Lower/smaller than the mature tree, naturally young growth, not scaled down adult crown. No olives or flowers. All branches botanically attached; no isolated round foliage pads, no cut ends, no collage.
Same refined natural-history painted realism and quiet warm material identity as approved source. Irregular individual leaf orientations, silvery undersides, varied density and shaded inner twigs, subtle matte light, no artificial glow or plastic sheen. Complete tree within same full canvas, no independent crop, zoom, rotation, backdrop, typography, labels, border or UI. Genuine RGBA transparency. This image is the younger age of this exact Lichtkrone, not a different generic sapling.

FaithPath Lichtkrone STAGE 4 GROWING OLIVE TREE, the intermediate age BETWEEN reference1 young tree and reference2 approved mature tree. One unified botanical illustration, transparent 1254x1254, same entire canvas, viewpoint, soil island at y1100–1205, root origin near (650,1100) and pale lower-right stone near (925,1145). Same individual S-curving trunk, taller left leader, deep bent low right limb. Do not swap to another species or another trunk geometry.
Compared with the young reference: moderately thicken the stem and root flare along the SAME load-bearing axes, develop more fine branching and a wider CONNECTED multi-layer crown. Crown is fuller than young but noticeably airier and less massive than the mature A4. Bark still fairly youthful with matte grey-umber grooves, the future central hollow remains a CLOSED elongated scar or shallow indentation, not a huge ancient hole. Roots have not yet become massive ropes. No olives and no flowers. No sawn or disconnected limbs.
Fine narrow opposite Olea europaea leaves, varied turns and silver-green undersides, same natural-history painted realism and warm upper-right lighting as both references. Connected inner twigs and overlapping airy foliage, no isolated round pads, no mechanical leaf stamps, no separate feather-bouquet collage. All existing main branches recognizably continue into the new fine twigs. Keep natural transparent pockets under the right arch. Quiet premium olive, sand and wood material. Full tree and soil island within canvas; no labels, ground scenery, paper, UI, glow or background. Real transparent RGBA. This is a slightly older version of reference1 moving toward reference2, not a miniature old bonsai or simply a globally resized picture.

FaithPath Lichtkrone STAGE 5 STRONG OLIVE TREE BEFORE FRUIT, a targeted age/content edit of the ATTACHED APPROVED MATURE MASTER. Transparent 1254x1254 square; preserve the same exact whole tree identity, S trunk, central hollow (shallower/smaller if needed), high left leader, low curved right elbow branch, root starts, warm upper-right light, lower-right pale stone, soil height and perspective.
Remove EVERY olive fruit and every flower. Repaint those small former fruit areas as naturally continuing fine twig/leaves/transparent gaps. There must be ZERO olives. Retain a dense coherent connected olive crown, but modestly more open around the LOWER outer sprays than the fully fruit-bearing master. No arbitrary bare chopped limbs; do not amputate the lower branches or form separate round tufts. Same detailed silvery green matte leaves, varied fine woody connections, calm organic light and bark. The entire crown must still look naturally grown as ONE tree.
Strong established trunk, more substantial than a young tree, with a recognizable off-centre hollow beginning. No larger or differently twisted roots than master. Do not turn the bark into shiny braided plastic. Preserve the clear tree-defining load-bearing axes and tree angle rather than inventing a new generic tree.
All extremities and leaf tips MUST be fully INSIDE the canvas with at least 20px clear transparent outer margin left/right/top. Do not clip a leaf mass at the right edge. Only local edge sprays may be shortened naturally to fit, do not crop/zoom or stretch whole tree. Root contact around (650,1100), soil base y1200. No backdrop, labels, UI, text, scenery, glow or gold halo. One premium connected botanical stage5 image only, true transparent RGBA, matching the approved master closely.

FaithPath Lichtkrone STAGE 6 FIRST FRUITS. This is a targeted edit of the ATTACHED APPROVED STAGE7 MASTER, not a new tree design. True transparent RGBA, same square 1254x1254 full canvas, camera, soil, pale lower-right stone and root contact. Preserve the source's exact S trunk, hollow position, high left leader, low bending right elbow limb and dense naturally CONNECTED canopy. No independently painted foliage tufts, no bare amputated branches, no globally cropped or stretched tree.
ESSENTIAL DIFFERENCE: remove ALMOST ALL fruit. Keep ONLY TWO small natural olive groupings total: one modest pair of greenish olives on an actual fine left branch around (340,540), and one small group of two or three purple/green olives on a fine right branch around (1010,550). These locations are approximate branch regions, attach fruit to an actual visible twig with short stems. NO other fruit anywhere, no fruit hidden all over the crown. This is first fruiting, not the abundant many clusters of the supplied source. No flowers.
Keep more foliage than the young/growing stages, but the canopy may be slightly more open at the extreme lower outer edges than the final mature source. Preserve its united natural whole-tree silhouette and connecting small branches. Same small opposite narrow olive leaves, matte silver-sage, irregular turns, subtle warm upper-right light, grey-umber tactile wood, no plastic sheen or artificial glow. Do not erase the tree's recognizable hollow or root anatomy. Maintain at least 18px transparent margin for all peripheral leaf tips, especially right edge. The actual approved source remains unchanged elsewhere in the project; this is its six-stage predecessor. No background, scenery, labels, text, border or UI. One unified botanical illustration only.
